summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Vale S.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting its interim financial statements for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026. The document presents consolidated and parent company income statements, statements of comprehensive income, and cash flow statements. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary periodic report under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, containing only standard financial results and operational metrics.
